_comment: Full OpenBB MCP profile — all categories enabled, discovery on, with prompts and system prompt. Copy to ~/.openbb_platform/mcp_settings.json to use.
OPENBB_MCP_DESCRIPTION: All OpenBB REST endpoints exposed as MCP tools. Full financial data access across all 21 categories and 38+ providers.
_note_system_prompt: Set OPENBB_MCP_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE to a path to override the bundled system prompt.
_note_prompts: Set OPENBB_MCP_SERVER_PROMPTS_FILE to a path to override or extend the bundled workflow prompts.
